IONTradeConsideration.title: IONTradeConsideration
IONTradeConsideration.description: ION trade consideration attributes. Inherits directly from RetailConsideration v2.1 and refines inherited breakup taxDetail objects with the shared IONTaxDetail schema.

breakup.description: Inherited RetailConsideration price breakup, refined so each taxDetail object may carry IONTaxDetail classification and compliance fields.

commission.description: Commission the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP) for the order. It is deducted from the seller's payout; it is not a charge to the buyer and is not part of breakup or totalAmount. On Offer.considerations it states the offer's terms; on the contract's price consideration it states the order's terms and total amount (see IONCommission).

IONCommission.title: IONCommission
IONCommission.description:
Commission the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP) for an order, deducted from the seller's payout at settlement. Not a charge to the buyer, and not part of breakup or totalAmount.
On Offer.considerations (the seller's terms for the offer): PERCENT is a percentage of the offer's item value, excluding tax (ITEM_TOTAL) or including tax (ORDER_TOTAL); AMOUNT is a fixed amount per unit sold. amount is not set.
On Contract.consideration (the price consideration in force): when every offer in the order has identical PERCENT terms the contract repeats them; otherwise type is AMOUNT and value is the order's total commission. amount is always the total commission for the items still ordered: the BPP sets it in on_select and on_init and recomputes it in on_cancel and on_update after cancellations and returns. At reconciliation the settlement's commission.value (IONSettlementReconciliation) equals it.

type.description: PERCENT applies value as a percentage of the appliesTo base. AMOUNT is a fixed amount in the consideration currency: per unit sold on an offer, the order's total on a contract.

value.description: Percentage (0-100) when type is PERCENT; amount in the consideration currency when type is AMOUNT.

appliesTo.description: Base for a PERCENT commission. ITEM_TOTAL is the item value excluding tax, delivery and packing; ORDER_TOTAL includes tax. Only for type PERCENT.

amount.description: The commission in the consideration currency for the items still ordered. Set on the contract's price consideration only.
